description: Implementation of quic_connection_context class and thread-local context management for different platforms (STARBOARD and non-STARBOARD).

classes.name: QuicConnectionContext
classes.description: Represents the context for a QUIC connection, with static method to get current context.

classes.name: QuicConnectionProcessPacketContext
classes.description: Holds information about packet processing, including a debug string method.

classes.name: QuicConnectionContextSwitcher
classes.description: Manages switching of the current connection context, activating and deactivating tracers.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the packet processing context, including payload info.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current QuicConnectionContext instance based on platform.

methods.name: QuicConnectionContextSwitcher
methods.description: Constructor that switches the current context to a new one, activating tracer if present.

methods.name: ~QuicConnectionContextSwitcher
methods.description: Destructor that restores the previous context and deactivates tracer if present.
